svg.aria-label: About. I build the software heavy industry runs on: the screens a plant floor works with, the services behind them, and the models that watch a line. React and TypeScript in front, C# and SQL Server behind, Python when something has to be seen. What I make belongs to the companies it runs in. What I can show is how it is built.
